text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond asked me to watch her, so I 
decided to accompany her to her dance 
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Do this, like this... And then next, like 
that—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Mmm, something's off. The ones at the 
top shouldn't be at just this level."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Building up even more momentum—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am terribly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Satono Diamond seems to 
be spinning her wheels.
choice_data_list: Is there something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... Kita-chan is a really good singer, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'm practicing hard as well, but one 
cannot reach that level overnight."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, I was thinking I'd at least like to be 
able to dance with confidence.
choice_data_list:
How about dancing to Kitasan Black's song 
instead?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Kita-chan sings so well surely 
because her fundamentals are rock solid.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I must re-examine my fundamental steps as 
well, and diligently build myself up from 
the ground up—
What's this, talking about dance steps~?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Teio-san!? ...Did you hear what we 
were just saying?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you were saying something about 
basic steps or whatever, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, when it comes to footwork, I'm your 
girl! I wouldn't mind teaching you if you 
want~?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(True, when you think of footwork, you 
think of Teio-san. But Teio-san is someone 
Kita-chan looks up to, too.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(It feels a bit awkward for only me to be 
asking for lessons here...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(—No, this is no time to hold back. I 
resolved to get better no matter what!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, could you please teach me your 
step?! It's just—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Please keep this a secret from 
Kita-chan. I'd feel bad, like I'm keeping 
Teio-san all to myself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see! In other words, it's a secret 
between Dia-chan and me? Nishishi, got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After learning steps from Tokai Teio, 
Satono Diamond's footwork was noticeably 
lighter and nimbler than before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My, through Kita-chan's singing...? I 
never would have thought of that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, that might actually be good. I 
feel like it'll make me want to push 
myself so I won't be drowned out by 
Kita-chan's voice!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Kita-chan's singing somehow feels so full 
of power and dynamic energy...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe what I was lacking... was this 
sheer power...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, I've gotta run stronger too!! 
More, even more――!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? A surge of passion is welling up 
inside me... and it feels so good!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, Satono Diamond kept dancing 
by herself, uttering words as she moved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was a little concerned, but... her 
movements were looking exceptionally 
sharp!
